kebab_example: aliyun paicopilot list-sessions --page-number 1 --sort-by GmtModified --order ASC --page-size 20 --labels system.product.type=DLC --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListSessions

parameters.help_en: The page number. Pages start from 1. Default value: 1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en:
The field by which to sort the results. Valid values:

- GmtCreateTime
- GmtModified
parameters.help_zh:
排序字段：支持以下字段

- GmtCreateTime
- GmtModified
parameters.name: sort_by

parameters.help_en:
The sort order. Valid values:

- ASC: ascending order
- DESC: descending order
parameters.help_zh:
排序方向：

- ASC 升序
- DESC 降序
parameters.name: order

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Default value: 20. Maximum value: 100
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The labels used to filter results. Separate multiple labels with commas. All specified labels must be matched
parameters.help_zh:
标签过滤值
以逗号分隔，必须全部满足
parameters.name: labels
